title: Four cards carried currency claims external verification did not support - a MACN founding-member status, a BMP Maritime Security 2026 edition the publisher does not label, an ISO 23306 citation with no currency statement at all, and a regulation 16 negative with no date
candidate_claim: Tranche 2C sections K-1, K-6, K-7 and K-8. K-1: Maersk own publication says MACN was an initiative it helped establish in 2011, which supports participation in establishment but not the phrase founding member. K-6: ISO 23306:2020 remains the current PUBLISHED standard, but ISO marks it to be revised and ISO/AWI 23306 edition 2 is under development, new work item registered 3 August 2026; the card must distinguish CURRENT PUBLISHED from UNDER DEVELOPMENT. K-7: no post-MEPC.328(76) amendment specifically changing regulation 16 incineration provisions was found in the current IMO Annex VI index as of September 2026; prefer a scoped currentness statement over an exhaustive negative. K-8: OCIMF identifies BMP Maritime Security as 1st Edition, 2025, updated in June/July 2026, so it must not be called the 2026 edition and no second edition may be invented.
candidate_verdict: UPHELD ON K-1 AND K-8. K-6 AND K-7 UPHELD IN SUBSTANCE WITH THEIR PREMISES CORRECTED ON THE RECORD. K-6: the card never contained no later edition or superseding standard has been issued or is underway, or any equivalent - a full-text sweep of QB7_D for superseding returns zero hits, so there was nothing to delete. What it carried was a bare ISO 23306:2020 with NO currency statement, which is a different and quieter defect: a citation with no date-of-check cannot age visibly, so nothing in the corpus would ever have flagged it. K-7: the card never said regulation 16 has never been amended - it said no amendment in the held in-force chain touches it, which is already scoped to its evidence. It was, however, scoped without a DATE, which is the undated-currentness defect class already on this repo record. K-8 was the largest: nine sites inside q13, including one Common CE Failures entry that the correction itself falsified and that had to be rewritten in the same act.

authority.macn: Maersk own publication states MACN was an initiative it helped establish in 2011. No primary MACN source held locally uses founding member. The claim is brought back to what the source supports and no further. The card three other establishment statements - founded in 2011 by shipping companies including Maersk, established in 2011 by maritime stakeholders including Maersk, Stena, Grieg and Odfjell, and Co-founded 2011 by Maersk and other majors - each already state participation alongside named others and are consistent with helped establish. They were adjudicated and left.
authority.iso_23306: ISO 23306:2020 remains the CURRENT PUBLISHED International Standard for LNG marine-fuel specification as at September 2026 and is the edition to quote. ISO has flagged it International Standard to be revised, and ISO/AWI 23306 edition 2 is UNDER DEVELOPMENT, new work item approved and registered 3 August 2026. An AWI is a work item, not a published standard. The card now states both halves and says in terms that the AWI must not be quoted as current or ordered to.
authority.annexvi_reg16: No later IMO amendment affecting the regulation 16 incineration provisions was identified in the held in-force chain, or in the current IMO Annex VI amendment index, as at September 2026. The recent amendments concern other provisions, the emission control areas and the NOx Technical Code. The claim is stated in that scoped and DATED form rather than as an exhaustive historical negative.
authority.bmp_ms: OCIMF identifies the publication as BMP Maritime Security, 1st Edition, 2025, updated during 2026 with the activist-boarding guidance. There is no second edition. The card is corrected to 1st Edition (2025), updated during 2026 at every site, and says explicitly that no second edition exists so a future editor does not reintroduce the label.

supersedes.note: H1-001 built this card. No correction record had touched it before this one.

changed_propositions: 15-second answer: The current edition is 2026 -> The current edition is the 1st Edition (2025), updated in 2026.

What it is and what it replaced: The current edition is the 2026 one, announced by the co-publishers in July 2026 -> it remains the 1st Edition dated 2025, the co-publishers issued an update to it during 2026 announced in July 2026, there is no second edition, and the reader is told to say 1st Edition (2025) updated 2026 and never the 2026 edition.
Block heading: What changed in the 2026 edition -> What the 2026 update changed.
CE Oral Tip four-facts list: current edition 2026 -> 1st Edition (2025) as updated in 2026.
Trap Questions: no, BMP MS replaced it in 2025 and the current edition is 2026 -> no, BMP MS replaced it in 2025, and it is the 1st Edition (2025) as updated in 2026, there is no second edition.
Trap Questions: the 2026 edition advises against confrontation -> the 2026 update advises against confrontation.

Common CE Failures: Teaching BMP5, or the 2025 first edition, as current -> Teaching BMP5 as current, or calling BMP MS the 2026 edition, with the publisher label given. THIS ENTRY WAS MADE WRONG BY THE CORRECTION ITSELF - the 2025 first edition IS current - and rewriting it in the same act is why it is listed rather than absorbed.
Numbers to Memorise: Current edition 2026; first edition announced 31 March 2025 -> 1st Edition, 2025, announced 31 March 2025, updated during 2026 announced July 2026, no second edition.
Reg-box code: BMP Maritime Security (2026 ed.) -> BMP Maritime Security (1st Ed. 2025, upd. 2026).

Source-confidence footer: an edition-label correction dated 5 September 2026 APPENDED, recording the publisher label and recording that the registry id SRC-BMPMS-2026 encodes the retrieval year, not an edition number.
deliberately_unchanged: The six publishing bodies, the 40-plus supporting stakeholders, the three replaced publications and their full titles.
The global-not-region-locked proposition, which is the card central teaching point.

The activist-boarding content of the 2026 update - Section 6, Incident Response, de-escalation, evidence preservation, and the advice against razor wire, water cannon and drone interference. Only its LABEL changed, never its substance.
The 2024 casualty figures, the MISTO reference, the citadel-versus-safe-muster-point discrimination and the machinery-space duties.
The footer statement that the publication is behind an access control and that the card asserts NO structure beyond Section 6.

docs/sources/MIW_SOURCE_REGISTRY.json. SRC-BMPMS-2026 is an identifier, not a candidate-facing claim, and renaming a registered source id is a governance change this tranche is not authorised to make.

changed_propositions: Body bullet, Regulation 16 is unamended: No amendment in the held in-force chain touches it, so the current text is the MEPC.328(76) text -> the claim is SCOPED AND DATED - no later IMO amendment affecting the regulation 16 incineration provisions was identified in the held in-force chain, or in the current IMO Annex VI amendment index, as at September 2026 - with the recent amendments named as concerning other provisions, the emission control areas and the NOx Technical Code, before the same MEPC.328(76) conclusion.
deliberately_unchanged: The reg-box entry for MEPC.328(76), which already says unamended by any amendment in the held in-force chain - scoped, not an exhaustive negative - together with its warning that secondary summaries circulate with the entry-into-force year wrong.

Every regulation 16 substantive proposition: the six prohibited substances of 16.2, the PVC / IMO Type Approval Certificate condition, the 1 January 2000 appendix IV date, the 19 May 2005 flag-waters cut-off, and the 850 degree and 600-degree-in-5-minutes temperature floors.
The Annex VI entry-into-force dates, which are a separate proposition from the regulation 16 currency.

propagation.scope_pass: Four independent sweeps. MACN: meoclass1/ for founding MACN member - one site, corrected; the remaining establishment statements were read individually rather than pattern-matched, because founded and established are legitimate words here. ISO: QB7_D for 23306, superseding and AWI - eight sites, none making a barred claim, two given the currency distinction. Reg 16: QB3_C for unamended and 328(76) - three sites, all already scoped, one given a date. BMP: meoclass1/ for 2026 edition, current edition 2026, current edition is 2026 and 2026 ed., mapped to owning cards by document position - nine sites inside QB4_H#q13, all corrected, and SIX sites outside it.
found_and_not_swept: The BMP 2026 edition label is live in six cards outside q13: QB4_H#q2 (Industry guidance, current edition 2026), QB4_H#q11 (three sites - current edition 2026 (see Q13), the current BMP MS edition is 2026, and a correction footer reading current edition 2026), QB4_B#q16, QB9_A#q9 and QB9_B#q5 (each the current edition is 2026). They were propagated by CORR-BMP-MS-CURRENCY-20260831. Correcting q13 alone leaves QB4_H internally inconsistent across q2, q11 and q13, and that is a DIRECT AND FORESEEABLE CONSEQUENCE of a gate scoped to one card. It is recorded rather than silently equalised, for the same reason CORR-GPT-T2A-GRAIN-20260905 recorded the q11 heading rather than fixing it under an authorisation that did not name it. REPORTED to GPT for tranche 3 as a single propagated-fact sweep.

docs/sources/MIW_SOURCE_REGISTRY.json entry SRC-BMPMS-2026 encodes the retrieval year in its identifier. Left untouched; the q13 footer now says so explicitly so that a reader does not take the id for an edition number. REPORTED.

invariants: No second edition of BMP Maritime Security is invented anywhere. The only two surviving occurrences of the string 2026 edition inside q13 are inside quotation marks in sentences teaching against it.
ISO/AWI 23306 is never stated as current, published, mandatory or orderable. The card says in terms that it is a work item.
The regulation 16 claim is not strengthened. It moves from an undated scoped negative to a dated scoped negative, and the reg-box and Numbers entries that were already scoped are untouched.
The MACN membership figure and its 1 September 2026 dating are unchanged.
No card in this record gains a new instrument, resolution number or standard number.

QB2_F#q3 was reviewed under K-9 and found already correct on MSC.1/Circ.1694, the 10 mg/kg (0.001% by weight) threshold, IACS UI SC309 and the 1 January 2026 dates. It is NOT declared by this record and is byte-identical.
QB7_D#q14 K-4 and K-5 propositions were adjudicated and NOT changed; q14 is declared only by CORR-GPT-T2C-LNGASPHYX-20260905, for a different block.
content_index_effect: None. Every card keeps its id, anchor and question text, so meoclass1/qb_content_index.json regenerates identically at 761 / 86.
note: Four cards, one subject: a claim about what is CURRENT. Three of the four defects were invisible to a fact check, because each claim was true when written - the failure mode is a claim that carries no date and so cannot be seen to have aged. That is why every correction in this record either adds a date or names a publisher label, and why the report says which premises in the brief the tree did not bear out.
